FULL TEXT:
Panjab University, Chandigarh
Advertisement for the walk-in interview for appointment for the Post
Doctoral Fellowship under RUSA2.0
Candidates are invited for walk-in- for the Post Doctoral Fellowship under RUSA 2.0, in
the following thrust areas (Social sciences and applied fields, Physical Sciences, Biological
Sciences (life Sciences), Engineering Sciences and Chemical Sciences) in the various
departments of Panjab University, Chandigarh. Eligible candidates are required to bring six
(06) hard copies of their application form along with educational qualification documents,
list of publications, detailed CV and 1500 words brief research proposal by e- mail to the
coordinator RUSA 2.0 Panjab University. The name of the post applying for must be clearly
mentioned in the subject line of the email. (Application form and research proposal format is
attached below).

Eligibility: (i) The candidate must have a doctorate degree (Submitted/Awarded) in the
relevant subject with published research work to their credit.
(ii) The upper age limit for applicants is 40 years, with relaxation in age for
SC/ST/OBC/Women candidates applicable as per Government of India Norms or 5 years.
*Preference will be given to candidates having experience in the relevant research area/patent
/industrial research experience.
Duration: Post-Doctoral Fellowship will be offered initially upto 30 September and can be
extended on the basis of performance and as per availability of funds in RUSA 2.0 scheme.
Fellowship: Rs. 1,00,000/- per month (consolidated)
General Instruction to Applicants
1. The prescribed essential qualification indicated are bare minimum, and mere possessions
of same will not entitle applicants to be offered the Fellowship. Therefore, applicants
should furnish details of all qualifications possessed in the relevant field and show the
documentary evidence at the time of interviews.
2. The institute reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all the advertised Fellowships.
3. Incomplete application will not be considered.
Note: No TA / DA shall be paid for attending the interview.

DECLARATION
I hereby declare that I have carefully read the instructions and particulars supplied to me and
that the entries made in this application form are correct to the best of my knowledge and
belief. If selected, I promise to abide by the rules and discipline of the Institute.
I note that the decision of RUSA, Panjab University is final in regard to selection. RUSA,
Panjab University shall have the right to take necessary action at any time after my selection,
provided it is found that I was admitted on false particulars furnished by me or my
antecedents prove that my continuance in the Project is not desirable. I agree that I shall abide
by the decision of RUSA, Panjab University, which shall be final.
